notes: IGI general rate 4.5% (Llei 11/2012 art. 57). Bullion 0: the law's investment-gold regime (Disposicio addicional quarta) taxes imports and physical deliveries of investment gold at 0% (bars >=995 fine; qualifying coins). Silver: plata/metalls preciosos appear nowhere in the law - 4.5/4.5. Duty null (EU customs union covers ch. 71, but no line-level page was opened).
